title: 交更
subject: handing over the keys on the last shift after thirty-one years
caption: Cantonese chamber pop with a real string quartet. Quartet recorded close in a small room so the bow noise and breath are audible, upright piano with felt dampening, a clarinet taking the counter-melody, brushed drums entering only in the last third, double bass pizzicato. Chamber-close and dry rather than cinematic, instruments in the same small space as the voice. Mature male voice, understated and conversational, almost entirely in a mid register with no belting. 74 BPM, A flat major. Dignified, withholding the advice he wants to give. No synth, no programmed drums, no pop production, no choir, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
三十一年 同一個更 同一個櫃
鎖匙我磨到光 我自己磨到光
今日我要交 交畀個廿四歲嘅細佬
佢好緊張 佢比我緊張

[Pre-Chorus]
我教佢邊個掣要撳兩次
我教佢邊張凳唔好坐 嗰張會跌

[Chorus]
交更
我以為會唔捨得 其實冇
我以為會講好多嘢 其實我只係講咗設備
真正想講嘅係「呢個地方唔值得你做三十年」
但我冇講 我冇資格講

[Verse]
佢問我「做咁久 覺得點」
我想咗一陣 我話「過得好快」
呢句話係真嘅 但唔係答案
我冇其他答案

[Chorus]
交更
我以為會唔捨得 其實冇
我以為會講好多嘢 其實我只係講咗設備
真正想講嘅係「呢個地方唔值得你做三十年」
但我冇講 我祝佢好運

[Outro]
鎖匙放落枱 我冇再望
出門口 行慢咗少少
